title: Niekie3202s Vanilla++
description: Vanilla++ is the best quality of life modpack!
body:
Vanilla++ is the best quality of life modpack!

This modpack has some amazing mods like a world map, litematica and Elytra Slot, to make it easier and more fun to play minecraft!

This modpack has a lot of optimization too, such as sodium, ModernFix and Chunky for more FPS.

This modpack also includes some mods that should be in vanilla, like appleskin, inventory blur, Just Enough items and Shulker box Tooltip.

I have included some resource packs and shaders to this pack, but feel free to decide what you use and what not! After all, that's what Minecraft is for.
